observation.description: The inline_handler_v1 language subset is discoverable only by iterating against generation refusals; the guide documents just the no-sibling-capture rule (backend/queries.md anti-pattern). Restrictions this arm hit, one generation cycle each: (1) 'dynamic computed member access is outside inline_handler_v1' — string indexing lower[i] and array-slot writes vec[slot] are refused, forcing charCodeAt/charAt walks for tokenizers and index-matched .map() accumulation for vector math (any retrieval-scoring or embedding handler hits this immediately); (2) defineJsMutation refuses an empty writes list ('requires declared writes') even for a read-only helper mutation an action calls via runMutation, forcing a false write declaration; conversely JSON.stringify/JSON.parse, Math, template literals, arrow helpers declared inside the handler, and String.fromCharCode ARE allowed but nothing says so. For an agent consumer the missing subset spec costs one generate-diagnose-rewrite loop per restriction.

competitorOutcome.description: Convex and Supabase functions run ordinary JavaScript/TypeScript (V8 isolates / Deno), so tokenizers and vector math are written naively; no equivalent authoring subset exists to document.

mustNotRegress: The fail-closed generation-time validation itself: refusing at generate with a positioned diagnostic (file/line/column, seen this arm) is the right failure site and far better than a runtime surprise.
smallestCoherentFix: A guide subsection (backend/queries.md or a new inline-handlers reference) that states the inline_handler_v1 subset: what is refused (dynamic computed member access, free identifiers outside the allowlist, sibling capture, empty writes) with the standard rewrites (charAt/charCodeAt walk, index-matched map, declared-superset writes), and what is allowed (JSON, Math, String statics, inner helpers, template literals).
acceptanceWitness: A consumer authoring a tokenizer/scoring handler finds the subset and the rewrite patterns in the guide before hitting the diagnostic; the guide snippet class covering the subset is CI-verified.
